analysis_scope: ViT-S/16 ImageNet-100 seed-matched comparison of AMP-trained and full-FP32-trained cohorts for Learned, Sinusoidal, and RoPE, n=6 seeds
primary_endpoint: rho_rel mapped through the same epsilon bracket at normalized accuracy q=0.5
equivalence_rule: Family-level equivalence is established only when the two-sided 90% paired t confidence interval for mean delta (AMP minus FP32) lies wholly within [-0.01,+0.01]. Otherwise the result is INCONCLUSIVE, not evidence of difference.
epsilon50_role: Reported descriptively in native family-specific epsilon units; no cross-family equivalence margin is imposed.
secondary_metrics: attack nAUC on an identical global rho support
noise nAUC on the same support

statistics.primary_ci: paired t 90% CI for TOST-compatible equivalence decision

claim_rule: A regime-generalization claim requires all three PE families to satisfy the rho50 equivalence rule and descriptive ranking preservation. Any family-level failure yields an overall INCONCLUSIVE bridge.
pairing_label: seed-matched unless bit-identical initialization and data-order provenance are independently demonstrated
anti_posthoc_note: The SESOI and decision rule were written to disk before calculating cohort differences. The margin is a fixed dimensionless rho_rel tolerance and is not derived from observed family gaps.
